label: It is impossible that there be no first…, from In sensible things there is an order of… and 4 more
meaning: ST I q.2 a.3 co., the secunda via: an observed order of efficient causes, no self-causation (a cause is prior to its effect and nothing is prior to itself), the per se ordering of caused causes, and the impossibility of an infinite per se series make it impossible that there be no first efficient cause. 'Quam omnes Deum nominant' is a separate claim outside this argument. The Comparator config also verifies five countermodels, one per premise (secundaViaNeedsOrder, ...NeedsCausePrior, ...NeedsNothingPriorToItself, ...NeedsPerSeOrder: the per accidens infinite series, ...NeedsNoRegress) and premisesJointlySatisfiable.
